fixtures.why: Story position (the brief's worked examples): opened, joined batch manager ARM, six batch rate changes, 134 redemptions in runs (the grouping), a withdrawal (#18) between them, left the batch, then three adjustments.
Closed on 2025-06-09 and quiet since: opened into a batch, left it, three redemptions (the last with a "today" line), then the owner closed the trove.
Liquidated: an open, then a liquidation with no other event between.
Fully redeemed: a redemption that cleared all the debt and left a zero-debt zombie trove.
Closed: redemptions against an owner-set rate, then the owner closed the trove.
Opened straight into a batch: one event, the open's join-batch variant.
Dust: an automated manager's adjustments, with runs of zero-change touches the server collapses into one row, and frequent owner rate changes.
